bar_closed_when: now_utc >= bar_timestamp + 86400 seconds, by the clock of the exchange response
benchmarks: buy and hold from the open of the day after start_date, one cost
200D only: same rule without the overheating term
data: Bitstamp BTCUSD daily bars, UTC midnight to midnight

data_checks.bar: open, high, low, close are plain positive decimals and low <= open, close <= high; otherwise stop
data_checks.missing_or_duplicate_day: stop and record nothing; the owner decides openly, old rows stay

evaluation.verdict_day: the first recorded day on which both minimums are met; the verdict is taken once, on all days from the start to that day; later recalculations are reference only
evaluation.worked: max drawdown smaller than buy and hold AND return per drawdown better than buy and hold, same days

execution: decision at the close of day D sets the position for day D+1, executed at the open of day D+1
name: BTC daily regime
positions: long or flat only, no leverage, no shorts
revision_changing_a_decision: always a stop, whatever its size
rounding: prices to 2 decimals, averages to 6 decimals before comparison, equity to 6 decimals each day
